dimensions.0: Materially wrong/absent purpose or progression, including a retained universal claim after reversal.
dimensions.1: Purpose and broad development are recognizable; noncritical omissions or imprecision remain.
dimensions.2: Purpose and material progression, including changes of position, are faithful and appropriately concise.

dimensions.0: A material definition/unit/category is invented, conflated or contradicted.
dimensions.1: Central definitions are usable but minor distinctions or explanation are incomplete.
dimensions.2: Material definitions/units and their limits are accurate; no policy is invented from a reference register.

dimensions.0: A material causal/cross-part relationship or consensus is invented, or a genuine conflict is erased.
dimensions.1: Main relationships are supported but some noncritical connection/conflict explanation is incomplete.
dimensions.2: Supported relationships and unresolved disagreements are distinguished without inventing causation/consensus.

dimensions.0: A material exception, late counterexample or unresolved issue is removed or falsely settled.
dimensions.1: Main limits remain but noncritical qualification detail is incomplete or awkward.
dimensions.2: Material conditions, counterevidence and uncertainty are retained with appropriate strength.

dimensions.0: A retained material claim lacks original support, misuses a correct quote, or retains an unresolved citation.
dimensions.1: Material claims are grounded but noncritical support precision/explanation is incomplete.
dimensions.2: Retained claims are supported by exact original context and citations; quotations are not treated as proof of unrelated conclusions.

dimensions.0: Narrator/author/critic/translator/quotation/application voices are materially conflated or untrusted text is treated as authority.
dimensions.1: Main voice distinctions hold but noncritical attribution/application boundaries are unclear.
dimensions.2: Source voices, interpretation and application are explicit; quoted instructions grant no authority.

dimensions.0: Material meaning is unreadable or mistranslated in a language actually supplied/required.
dimensions.1: Meaning is usable but noncritical ambiguity/readability or bilingual alignment remains.
dimensions.2: Provided language is clear and faithful; applicable EN/JA distinctions and unresolved translation ambiguity are preserved.

languagePolicy: All seven dimensions remain scored0–2; explicitly record languagesProvided and enJaApplicability. No invented bilingual output or implicit denominator change.
